name: Maha Vilwadi Lehyam

sections.introduction: Maha Vilwadi Lehyam is a poly herbal formulation that is prepared from the mixture of herbs. This is mainly known to contain vilwamula, commonly known as bael root. This formulation is known to treat the problems related to bowel and digestion.
sections.ingredients:
Each 10 gram contains:- 

 Vilwamula (Aegle marmelos) – 4.800 g 
 Guda (Jaggery) – 4.800 g 
 Honey – 1.333 ml 
 Ginger – Zingiber officinale – 0.480 g 
 Chitraka – Plumbago zeylanica – 0.160 g 
 Maricha (Piper nigrum) – 0.640 g 
 Pippali (Piper longum) – 0.320 g 
 Chavya (Piper cubeba) – 0.160 g 
 Kesara (Crocus sativa) – 0.080 g 
 Karpura (Cinnamomum camphora) – 0.010 g 
 Pippalimula (Piper longum) – 0.320 g 
 Jeeraka (Cuminum cyminum) – 0.320 g 
 Trijata – Each of following up to 0.040 g:- 


 Cinnamomum zeylanicum – dalchinni 
 Elettaria cardamomum – ilaichi 
 Cinnamomum tamala – patra 

 Method of Preparation 

 Take Vilwamula and put in a container. 
 Add water to that container and heat the mixture till the water is reduced up to one fourth level. 
 After boiling process, filter the solution. 
 The collected filtrate is known as herbal decoction. 
 To the decoction, add jaggery and boil to get semi solid consistency. 
 Then add all other ingredients to the mixture to get leham. 
 At last add honey to the mixture.
sections.properties_of_maha_vilwadi_lehyam: This Ayurvedic medicine is prepared to manage various digestive problems like indigestion, vomiting, diarrhea, IBS (Irritable Bowel syndrome) etc. It supports the good health of digestive system as it improves the digestion process. In the problem of indigestion, it helps to ease the symptoms like abdominal pain, loss of appetite, nausea, vomiting, bloating, flatulence etc. For IBS use of this medicine is quiet good as it helps to increase the digestive fire and eliminate the accumulated toxins (ama) from body. Maha Vilwadi Lehyam is useful medicine to relieve the constipation. It is quite effective medicine to manage the piles (hemorrhoids). It reduces the internal pressure which results in the swelling of the veins. Anthelminthic properties of this medicine help to eliminate the intestinal worms. In short this medicine eliminates all the waste materials from body. Anti-microbial action of this medicine, is quite good to manage the diarrhea as it combat against the bacterial infections. Decongestant properties of this medicine help to relieve the problem of coughing.
sections.indications:
Indigestion 
 Vomiting 
 Piles 
 IBS 
 Diarrhea 
 Cough 
 Intestinal worms 
 Bloating 
 Abdominal tumor 
 Loss of appetite
sections.dose: 5 grams to 15 grams, before or after meals.
sections.contraindications:
Avoid in pregnancy. 
 Take medicine under doctor’s prescription. 


 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.

fullContent:
Maha Vilwadi Lehyam 
 Introduction 
 Maha Vilwadi Lehyam is a poly herbal formulation that is prepared from the mixture of herbs. This is mainly known to contain vilwamula, commonly known as bael root. This formulation is known to treat the problems related to bowel and digestion. 
 Ingredients 
 Each 10 gram contains:- 
 
 Vilwamula (Aegle marmelos) – 4.800 g 
 Guda (Jaggery) – 4.800 g 
 Honey – 1.333 ml 
 Ginger – Zingiber officinale – 0.480 g 
 Chitraka – Plumbago zeylanica – 0.160 g 
 Maricha (Piper nigrum) – 0.640 g 
 Pippali (Piper longum) – 0.320 g 
 Chavya (Piper cubeba) – 0.160 g 
 Kesara (Crocus sativa) – 0.080 g 
 Karpura (Cinnamomum camphora) – 0.010 g 
 Pippalimula (Piper longum) – 0.320 g 
 Jeeraka (Cuminum cyminum) – 0.320 g 
 Trijata – Each of following up to 0.040 g:- 
 
 
 Cinnamomum zeylanicum – dalchinni 
 Elettaria cardamomum – ilaichi 
 Cinnamomum tamala – patra 
 
 Method of Preparation 
 
 Take Vilwamula and put in a container. 
 Add water to that container and heat the mixture till the water is reduced up to one fourth level. 
 After boiling process, filter the solution. 
 The collected filtrate is known as herbal decoction. 
 To the decoction, add jaggery and boil to get semi solid consistency. 
 Then add all other ingredients to the mixture to get leham. 
 At last add honey to the mixture. 
 
 Properties of Maha Vilwadi Lehyam 
 This Ayurvedic medicine is prepared to manage various digestive problems like indigestion, vomiting, diarrhea, IBS (Irritable Bowel syndrome) etc. It supports the good health of digestive system as it improves the digestion process. In the problem of indigestion, it helps to ease the symptoms like abdominal pain, loss of appetite, nausea, vomiting, bloating, flatulence etc. For IBS use of this medicine is quiet good as it helps to increase the digestive fire and eliminate the accumulated toxins (ama) from body. Maha Vilwadi Lehyam is useful medicine to relieve the constipation. It is quite effective medicine to manage the piles (hemorrhoids). It reduces the internal pressure which results in the swelling of the veins. Anthelminthic properties of this medicine help to eliminate the intestinal worms. In short this medicine eliminates all the waste materials from body. Anti-microbial action of this medicine, is quite good to manage the diarrhea as it combat against the bacterial infections. Decongestant properties of this medicine help to relieve the problem of coughing. 
 Indications 
 
 Indigestion 
 Vomiting 
 Piles 
 IBS 
 Diarrhea 
 Cough 
 Intestinal worms 
 Bloating 
 Abdominal tumor 
 Loss of appetite 
 
 Dose 
 5 grams to 15 grams, before or after meals. 
 Contraindications 
 
 Avoid in pregnancy. 
 Take medicine under doctor’s prescription. 
 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
